title: Leite assado
creator: biricuticus_
steps: Mix everything except one yolk in a pan until smooth, then stir over the heat until it becomes a thick cream.
Pour into a dish lined with cling film, cover the surface and chill at least 4 hours.
Cut into cubes and set on a non-stick sheet or silicone mat (not baking paper, it sticks).
Brush with the remaining yolk and bake or air-fry at 190 °C for 20–25 minutes until golden, turning in the air fryer to brown both sides.
